notes:
Pilot: started from the current contractor.json (pattern project, reviewed), since an interior design job runs the same way: a paid visit at the home, a written quote days later, a signed agreement, money only after signing, several project visits, change orders, and the last bill after a walk-through. Dropped from the pilot: permits, inspections, the floor test, stage bills during the work. Kept and reworded: the cancel window and the change order.
Names: flow B is Lee Interiors (home and office design, 410 Park Ave), with Nadia Brooks (lead designer, the only one with a license, for office design) and Leo Park (designer). Flow A is Lee Sample Studio, Sam's second company (the master's barbershop): a design studio and sample library at 61 Grove St, with Mira Chen and Cora Diaz (studio designers). Alex lives at 26 Linden St. Old flowchart: Hannah = Alex, Coastal Palm Interiors = Lee Interiors; Nadia and Leo keep their names, Nadia is staff here and Sam is the owner.
Sign-up: Sam's three kinds of work are home design, office design and the sample studio. Interior design is licensed in only a few states, and business spaces in some, so S1-60, S1-63 and S2-28 keep both branches (splitsKept). The example: home design and the studio give their business registration only (S1-61, S1-64); office design waits for Nadia's license (S1-39, S2-06, S2-11). Protected titles like 'registered interior designer' show only as checked (pf.license, S13-11).
Prices: the master's $89 visit fee became the $175 in-home consultation (also the late-cancel and no-show fee on card paths, never more than a price it applies to); the $179 drain is the color consultation, the $150 flush the furniture layout plan (paid in full, its late fee $75 so it never passes the price), the $640 water heater the guest room refresh from photos (25% deposit, $160), the $199 camera inspection the lighting plan (its written plan comes later: B10-25), labor $120 an hour is extra design time. The studio keeps the master's $35, $40, $20, $25, $140 ($40 held), $90 from photos and $25 consult; the $55 shave became the $150 video design consultation, with its refund math fixed ($130).
The old flowchart charged the $250 consultation at DONE and credited it to the design fee. The overlay uses the master's visit-fee model instead: the $175 counts toward the $4,800 design fee and is billed alone only if no agreement follows (B8-21, B9-28). Project money: $2,400 retainer when signed (B8-63), $1,200 change order (B8-x11), $3,600 last payment at the walk-through (B8-41, B9-05, B9-06), $6,000 receipt (B10-01).
Main path B (visit|card|bill): B4-14 and B4-15 promise only the consultation; B4-x01 notes the wall for Alex's own contractor; B8-20 the written proposal (Sam OKs it, over $500); B8-62 the agreement; B8-63 the retainer and Leo's measuring visit; B8-x04 the cancel window; B8-x06 the link for Alex's contractor (site meeting); B8-37 the project plan (presentation at the office, install day); B8-x11 the dining-room change order; B8-x13 furniture ordered outside Rosie; B8-39 the walk-through with the fix list (a scratched chair, the maker's claim, the redelivery); B8-41 DONE; B9 the texted bill with bank transfer.

Money combinations B: visit|card|bill (main), visit|card|own (Sam bills the retainer and the last payment his own way: the old flowchart's own-invoice path), visit|card|card (the saved card charged at DONE: the old flowchart charged its consultation to the saved card after the visit; here only the $175 if Alex doesn't sign, or the last $3,600 at the walk-through), list|card|bill (color consultation, lighting plan), list|full|none (furniture layout plan; the studio's sample review at home), photos|deposit|bill (room refresh). Left out: holds (designers save a card), deposits on the consultation.
Money combinations A: list|card|card (main: Saturday morning, nobody at the studio desk, so the card is charged at DONE), list|card|counter (weekdays at the desk), list|hold|counter (full-room studio session, $40 held), list|full|none (video design consultation, e-design), photos|card|counter (window treatment design), visit|card|counter (custom furniture design after a $25 consult).

Sign-up money steps S1-13, S1-14, S1-16, S1-17 and S1-18 get the plug-in's real table in both flows (words ops), so no service shows a hold it doesn't take. The office consultation costs $175, not free, so its no-show fee never passes its price.
